$comment: ADR-325: where AI humans (virtual players) spawn and respawn. points: world-wide AI spawn points generated from the seed (a Vogel spiral of `count` points between minRadius and maxRadius tiles from the origin, each snapped to a clear walkable patch within searchTiles; plus up to abandonedSites points beside seeded abandoned buildings). The 4 ADR-106 player spawn points are part of the set but count as player areas. pick: least-populated weighting (1 / (1 + crowd)^crowdPow, crowd = live humans/bots within crowdRadius + pending spawns), at least minPlayerDist tiles from every human player and player spawn point; with probability nearPlayerShare a point nearer players is allowed, but never closer than onScreenTiles. respawn: dead AI humans go to their bed, then their home (AI memory base) when homeFirst, then a distributed point; hired workers and clan members keep the ADR-153 rule (bed, else nearest spawn point).
